usb_ep0_donor.scope: Generic DWC3 EP0 state machine only; no Qualcomm addresses, power or PHY code copied

board_register_evidence.reset_registers: PMU11860000; MAGIC0808, PANIC080c; SYSIP_DAT00810; SWRESET3a00 bit1
board_register_evidence.hsi_power_status: PMU+0x1c84 mask BIT(0), per flexpmu hsi_status and hsi_on; video183651 reads1
board_register_evidence.usb2_endpoint_commands: gadget.c dwc3_send_gadget_ep_cmd: save/clear GUSB2PHYCFG SUSPHY BIT6 and ENBLSLPM BIT8 for USB2 commands; restore on exit. core.h confirms masks. AUTO2 times out on command1 after soft reset; post-reset sleep state not yet observed.

limitations: Source-derived implementation; XCover5 USB enumeration and reset not hardware verified yet.
Bootloader PHY/clock state must remain usable; cold PHY initialization is not implemented.
First1MiB of post-serial framebuffer console retained; overflow blocks ACK/reset.
No snapshot on early panic, hard hang, power loss, or a test that never exits.
No eMMC writes, no firmware flashing command in USB protocol.
